text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер gains a little bit of
confidence after
she answers the cheers
of the people from
Kokura's shopping
district with a great race
result.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With this confidence, Найс Нэйчер
aspires to run
in the Kikuka Sho to
challenge Токай Тэйо.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before leaving Kokura the following day,
I give
Найс Нэйчер a handmade origami
trophy as a
token of her growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер seems to be touched by the
gesture,
and states that she will do her
best in the next
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
